2099-2169-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-2169-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

3899-5394-6291.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

510-2281-3899.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

586-944-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-944-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-4365-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
3129-4094-4365-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3375-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

5078-5901-6089.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
5078-5901-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

3234-3946-5686-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
3234-3946-5686-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

792-1580-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-3195-6972.description:
Activate Dromar's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Dromar's Attendant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

4460-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

757-2085-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on it and skipping your next turn.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

3443-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-7282-7340.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-2499-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve both Sailor of Means triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

877-4518-6986.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-554-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-3967.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

962-1029-5028.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
962-1029-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

81-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
81-4067-5672.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1617-3122-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Undercover Operative on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-3122-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Undercover Operative to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

2423-2440-4183-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis
2423-2440-4183-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

222-527-5223-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-2556-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2556-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1808-2837-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

608-1308-2022-2034-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
608-1308-2022-2034-5495.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1283-2416-2816.notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2416-2816.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Rise and Shine by paying {2}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability if you control a colored permanent.

575-2860-4786.description:
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Proteus Machine.
When Proteus Machine dies, Yedora triggers, returning Proteus Machine to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Claws of Gix ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

481-2160-2647.manaNeeded: {R}{R} the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} available each extra turn
481-2160-2647.notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
481-2160-2647.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying {R}{R}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Warrior's Oath, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Warrior's Oath from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, Warrior's Oath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the Warrior's Oath trigger from the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

102-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Graf Reaver either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Graf Reaver enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Graf Reaver dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

647-719-3742-4251-4344.notablePrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Xenograft.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
647-719-3742-4251-4344.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1424-2335-2850.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2335-2850.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

751-1622-2792.description:
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Minion Reflector.
Resolve Great Whale's trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve Minion Reflector's trigger, paying {2} to create a token copy of Great Whale.
The Great Whale token enters the battlefield, triggering itself, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Minion Reflector.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's trigger, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Minion Reflector's trigger, paying {2} to create a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
The Shrieking Drake token enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If your seven lands can produce at least {5}{U}{U}, this combo produces infinite mana.
